$Comment: A dungeon skill lock, the root wall (Woodcutting's): the game's thick hanging roots (Plant_Vine_Thick_Roots' model and textures), made solid so a column of them closes a doorway. Using it does nothing on its own, so the use reaches the room's trigger volume, whose ZigRequires opens it for a player with the skill and whose RejectionEffects tell anyone else what opens it (the SkillLock room template, tools/rooms). It has no Gathering, so no survival player, creature or explosion can break it and it drops nothing; it has no recipe and no category and is a Variant, so the creative library hides it. It needs no support and is not climbable.
